clusters.reasoning: All provided raw files appear to belong to the same overarching biological system described in the publication (UBXD1–ubiquitin–p97/VCP) and the PRIDE metadata indicates Homo sapiens. Because no explicit BPA/photo-Met identifiers are present in filenames, the smallest meaningful split is a single DSSO cluster for the dataset.
